nodes.title: HIRES: H3 Hires Fix (taeh3 encode, LBH upscale, 2 DMAD steps from 0.45, audio pinned)
HIRES: DMAD turbo 0.8 for the refine (take already fixed)
HIRES: shift for the refine model
HIRES: FaceDetail's 512 px face tiles stitched onto the hires frames (chunked: long clips stay in RAM)
HIRES: Hold Transfer (exact 2s/3s holds of the 1 MP clip; never re-run Anime Cadence here)

widgets_values:
FAST DE-ROPE + ANIME CADENCE

Same smear fix as the 2-pass MAINodes de-rope, with the extra cost roughly halved (Re:Zero i2v 1024x576x124 on a 5090: 246 s -> 167 s; a plain render is ~100 s).
Why H3 smears: the latent CAN hold crisp fast poses (VAE round trip is clean); the DiT paints blur when a latent token has to carry fast motion inside it. The de-rope's holds give each fast pose its own static token, but the slowed clip is 2-3x longer and full attention grows with the square of its length.
H3 Window Attention: in pass 2 each frame attends exactly to its neighbours (+-4 latent frames), every 8th frame as an anchor, and all text/audio/first-frame rows. Pass 2 ~40% faster; fast poses came out as crisp or crisper than dense attention in our tests. window 2 is faster but starts inventing effects.
taeh3 does the throwaway decode/encode of the slowed clip (34 s -> 2 s); the int8 video VAE does the final decode.
Audio is pass 1's normal soundtrack (Exact Recover keeps pass 1's timing).

1 MP -> 1920x1088 after the anime pipeline (see the ResCascade README). The 1 MP pipeline decides everything (motion, de-roped impacts, faces, cadence, audio). H3 Hires Fix redraws only lines/texture at 1920 (DMAD is free here). Small faces would be redrawn badly at 1920, so FaceDetail's own face tiles are stitched again at hires. Re-running Anime Cadence after hires can hold the wrong drawing over an impact frame, so Hold Transfer copies the 1 MP holds instead. Edgerunners wide street: 345 s total (1 MP pipeline ~248 s + hires ~98 s).
